story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain from code, not observed. A lattice tower's camera spins once and leaves a watch ring. 16 of 56 slots light. At the tower's foot the beam finds a plume and a flag locks on it. An alert card leaves the head and runs down the coax toward a truck, then lands as a bubble on a gloved crew phone. A watch on that wrist shows a hatched window up to ten minutes, marked estimated. Wide, the beam holds on the still-burning plume, with the windmill, the truck carrying the landed alert and a small fire station in the same view. A cut in toward the truck and station shows a dashed line from the alert stop short of the station's badge. A shelter calendar since launch has no red mark. A blank record on the truck's tailgate stays empty. The filed plan waits on state approval above the still-sweeping tower, the landed alert and the open line.
story_review.opening_to_ending: Opens on a camera watching all the way around. By about 17 s it shows that a text reaches the utility's crew. It then states the limits in one continuous s5 world and closes on a composite that shows the answer under the pending plan.
